rules.name: On the Hunt
rules.description: The Chinese Battlegroup is avoiding a large-scale battle following a string of territorial losses. The enemy appears weak and easily destroyed. At the start of the game, roll a D6 and add the result to the Battlegroup’s total BR.

rules.name: Fractured Loyalty
rules.description: The Chinese Battlegroup officers refuse to receive orders unless directly given by a local warlord. For the first two turns, the Chinese only roll D6 for orders, with no modifiers for officers or re-rolls. From turn 3 onwards, he may start to roll for orders as normal.

rules.name: Aircraft Table
rules.description:
1-3 Ki-32 'Mary' Light Bomber
4-5 A6M 'Zero' Fighter
6    Player's Choice of Aircraft (Still roll for Armaments)

You may always choose an aircraft from lower on the table than your roll. You must still roll for armament.
